selection_rule: First mathematically passing candidate at <= half tolerance whose supplied FP64 probe rejects; first mathematically failing candidate at >= twice tolerance whose supplied FP64 probe passes.
calibration: No discarded calibration. Four rows, eight positive small terms, opposite +/-2^30 interior pair, +/-2^80 endpoints, 1e-5 tolerance and this 256-seed sweep were fixed before the first CPU search, GPU validation and any model calls.
